allOf.description: The schema inferred from the streaming source. It identifies the format of the data in the streaming source and how each data element maps to corresponding columns in the in-application stream that you can create.
An array of elements, where each element corresponds to a row in a stream record (a stream record can have more than one row).
The stream data that was modified by the processor specified in the InputProcessingConfiguration parameter.
The raw stream data that was sampled to infer the schema.
